description: Prominent Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong was sentenced to 10 years in prison Thursday for his second conviction under a Beijing-imposed national security law, in a case that critics say reflects the crackdown on the city's once-thriving pro-democracy movement.
title: Prominent Hong Kong activist Joshua Wong sentenced to 10 years in 2nd national security case

description: Dancing in the streets, popping champagne and high-fiving fans was all part of the celebration on Wednesday as the Golden State Valkyries parade made its way through Oakland and then across the bay in San Francisco.
title: Valkyries celebrate WNBA championship with San Francisco and Oakland fans

description: Jodi Harisson-Lee tells the National about the moment her friend Karl Bushby finally returned home to the U.K. after completing a 28-year walk around the world that began from the southern tip of Chile.
title: He just wrapped a 28-year walk around the world | The Moment

author: Meghan Grant
description: A Calgary woman who admitted to stealing thousands of dollars from elderly victims was handed a 12-month jail sentence plus a year of probation after the judge refused to allow her to back out of her guilty plea.
title: Judge rejects grandparent scammer's bid to back out of guilty plea, sends her to jail instead

description: Parts of Ontario and Quebec have been experiencing record-setting temperatures this week, and people have been taking full advantage of it.
title: Beach weather in November? In Canada? These photos prove it

author: Sophia Laporte
description: Unmanaged menopause symptoms are not just impacting women, but costing the Canadian economy $3.5 billion and 540,000 lost workdays every year, according to the Menopause Foundation of Canada.
title: Unmanaged menopause symptoms cost Canada's economy $3.5B, experts tell MPs

author: Murray Brewster
description: A Canadian military counterintelligence operative accused of sharing sensitive information with Ukrainian intelligence will face court martial beginning Dec. 9. Master Warrant Officer Matthew Robar faces three charges related to unauthorized dealings with a foreign entity, misleading his superiors and improperly storing a firearm. He was originally charged with eight offences.
title: Canadian military counterintelligence operative to face court martial in spy case

description: One of NASA's premier space telescopes plunged to Earth on Wednesday, ending its 22-year investigation of gamma ray bursts and exploding stars.
title: NASA's Swift space telescope plunges to Earth after 22 years in orbit
National chief didn't mean to 'hurt anybody' with remarks on Métis identity

author: Sis'moqon
description: Deb Haaland and Peggy Flanagan have made history in the U.S. midterm elections, becoming the first Native American woman elected governor and U.S. senator, respectively, marking a milestone for Indigenous political representation in the U.S.
title: Native American women make history in U.S. midterm elections

author: Mike Crawley
description: U.S. Vice-President JD Vance blamed the Republican Party's decisive defeat in the midterm elections on the war that President Donald Trump launched against Iran.
title: JD Vance blames Iran war for midterm thumping. Is he really blaming Trump?

description: Donald Trump just joined a rare presidential club – he's the third-ever U.S. president to lose both the House and Senate in the midterms. CBC's Mike Crawley looks at the former presidents who also faced similar congressional busts.
title: Trump lost Congress. 3 presidents before him did, too

author: Creeson Agecoutay
description: Assembly of First Nations National Chief Cindy Woodhouse Nepinak says in the 2026 federal budget she wants to see sustained funding for First Nations services and infrastructure and the resources First Nations need to file specific claims.
title: Infrastructure gap and specific claims top issues for Assembly of First Nations for federal budget

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Some consumers in the U.K. are in an uproar after cereal-maker Kellogg's recently changed its recipe there for Rice Krispies, replacing the whole rice grains in the family-favourite breakfast with rice flour.
title: Kellogg's Rice Krispies changed its U.K. recipe, muffling its iconic snap, crackle and pop

author: Alexandra Mae Jones
description: Late night host Jimmy Kimmel had some choice words for U.S. President Donald Trump last night as a “blue tsunami” stormed the country during the U.S. elections, quipping in the monologue of ABC's Jimmy Kimmel Live! that Trump was "already running out of dipping sauce containers to throw at the television set."
title: Jimmy Kimmel roasts Trump in late night monologue amid 'blue tsunami' midterms
Canada-U.S. trade minister says Democrats' midterm landslide doesn't change Ottawa's strategy

author: Darren Bernhardt
description: Connor Hellebuyck has posted a letter to Winnipeg Jets fans on his social media page, expressing gratitude to them, the organization and Manitoba's lakes.
title: Connor Hellebuyck posts open letter 'to the great Jets fans'

author: Peter Zimonjic
description: The federal government announced on Wednesday that China will extend its soon-to-expire tariff-free treatment for some Canadian agricultural and seafood products for another two years.
title: China extends tariff relief for Canadian canola, lobster and crab

description: Canada's secretary of state for sport dismissed concerns Wednesday that barring Russian players from next month's world junior hockey championship in Alberta could hurt the country's chances of hosting future international events, including the Olympics.
title: Canada dismisses fears of international blowback over Russian world junior hockey ban

author: Chris Iorfida
description: With hundreds of elections taking place Tuesday night for U.S. Congress and state-level offices, there were trailblazers aplenty. Perhaps the most remarkable outcome was the election of Black governors, surpassing the previous total number in just one night.
title: Until the midterms, only 3 Black governors were ever elected in U.S. Tuesday saw 5 wins

author: Jessica Wallace
description: Marissa Ross was driving from Bridge Lake to Royal Inland Hospital in Kamloops to give birth to her fourth baby. But she didn't manage to make it to the hospital before her daughter made an appearance.
title: B.C. mom delivers baby on side of highway while en route to Kamloops hospital

description: Israeli President Isaac Herzog said he would begin consultations with party representatives on the formation of a new government after accepting the certified results from last week's parliamentary elections, effectively pushing aside claims of voter fraud.
title: Israeli president accepts certified election results after commission denies voter fraud

author: Kyle Duggan
description: Former prime minister Stephen Harper says he offered Mark Carney, then the governor of the Bank of Canada, a role in his Conservative government in 2012 — though not as finance minister. Not right away, at least.
title: In new memoir, Harper says he offered Carney a job — but not finance minister

description: The main sponsor of the men's ice hockey world championship, automaker Skoda, says it will "reassess" its backing for the tournament if Russia takes part.
title: Hockey world championship main sponsor Skoda to 'reassess' backing if Russia plays

author: Jesmeen Gill
description: An Edmonton Remand Centre employee testified on Tuesday that she recalled hearing Daniel Robinson repeatedly plead for help as correctional officers restrained him on the floor outside a cell at the facility five years ago.
title: Inmate told officers he was struggling to breathe, jail employee tells fatality inquiry

description: Iranian officials celebrated U.S. voters' rebuke of the Republican P
title: Iranian officials welcome U.S. midterm results after voters rebuke Trump administration, Iran war

author: Jeff Lagerquist
description: Google launched a new online shopping tool in Canada on Wednesday, allowing complete purchases via chat with its AI agent.
title: Google launches AI-based shopping in Canada in race to dominate e-commerce

author: Anand Ram
description: Nearly 30 years after the original, Nintendo has remade The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time. It’s an unquestionable fan favourite that’s shinier, but retains the soul of a game that isn’t made like this anymore.
title: Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time's gorgeous remake retains the original's soul

author: Bernice Hillier
description: A survivor of intimate partner violence says no one told her in advance that her attacker was out of prison, even though she was registered with Victim Services. The Department of Justice and Public Safety won't comment on the specific case but says, if a victim has asked for information about an inmate's release, "attempts will be made to inform the victim."
title: Woman who was beaten by her ex-husband says 'life could've been in jeopardy' after N.L. justice department didn't tell her about his release

author: Natalie Stechyson
description: Every year, amid our current running boom, more and more people vie for the chance to lace up their sneakers and push themselves 42.2 kilometres to cross that finish line. But every year, young and seemingly healthy people also die trying.
title: A runner died in the New York City Marathon. Have the risks changed as more people race?

author: Murray Brewster, Daniel Leblanc
description: Canada wants to split its planned purchase of 12 German submarines, committing to eight up front while leaving the remaining four for a future decision. Sources tell CBC News the proposal is intended to preserve financial flexibility but could jeopardize some of the $86 billion in economic benefits promised by Germany.
title: Canada looking to Germany for 8 submarines up front and 4 later: sources

author: Inayat Singh
description: Canada does not need to shut down its industries or take a catastrophic financial hit to effectively fight climate change, one of the country's leading climate scientists testified during a landmark trial in a Vancouver courtroom this week.
title: No catastrophic financial hit required to fight climate change, scientists say in landmark court case

author: Jason Markusoff
description: The last boundary panel's chair urged the new panel not to alter ridings in southern Alberta. They did.
title: The give and take (and partisan wrangling) in Alberta's urban-rural hybrid riding maps
